description: The file contains unit tests for the ZookeeperMembershipTable component in the Orleans framework, specifically testing its integration with ZooKeeper-based membership management. It defines a test class with methods for creating the membership table and gateway list provider, as well as various test cases related to ZooKeeper operations like insertion, update, and concurrency handling.

classes.name: ZookeeperMembershipTableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing ZooKeeper-based membership table operations within Orleans. It verifies correct handling of ZooKeeper-specific features such as znodes, ephemeral nodes, and concurrency control during membership management.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures logging filters specific to the test class to enable detailed trace logs during tests.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Overrides base method to instantiate a ZooKeeper-based membership table using configured connection string and dependencies.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Overrides base method to instantiate a ZooKeeper-based gateway list provider to maintain up-to-date gateway tracking.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Asynchronously checks ZooKeeper availability and returns the connection string if reachable, or null otherwise.
